notes: Describes the accepted src/LaunchToken.sol and src/SignalBoard.sol. Both constructors are nonpayable and argument-free. SignalBoard has no dependencies or privileged roles and needs no initialization calls. The pool pairs with native ETH and has no hook; initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96. Unresolved authorization finding: the approved brief forbids ERC-20 creation, minting and deployment, liquidity pools and token allocations, while the accepted LaunchToken and required evm_project launch path include a token and pool. This remains an admission and deployment blocker. Resolution requires either explicit requester authorization for token creation, minting, deployment, a liquidity pool and policy allocations, or a service-supported application-only Sepolia deployment path with corresponding checks and a replacement manifest. Independent review must verify the resolution before admission; these notes do not authorize an exception. The brief permits only the Sepolia test/demo network (chain 11155111), never mainnet. Chain selection and enforcement belong to deployment services; this manifest does not enforce the network. Policy and signed artifact linkage are service responsibilities.
